originalJudgment.manualArithmetic: Divide Gm1m2/r² by its value at fixed nonzero r0: ratio1/x², with x=r/r0. References1=>1 and2=>1/4; actual transfer x11/4 gives16/121. Finite long division160000=121*1322+38 yields0.1322; relative error19/80000<0.005, so the Number-only grader has a feasible manual input. This reviewer procedure is not claimed as text supplied by the source. No numeric G or astronomical masses needed.
